<script type="application/x-gensrpg-disabled" id="dungeonCore091PostCombatUnlock">
(function(){
"use strict";

function hide091(id){
  const e=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!e)return;
  e.classList.remove("open","dc036ActiveCombat");
  e.classList.add("dc091Closed");
  e.style.setProperty("display","none","important");
  e.style.setProperty("pointer-events","none","important");
  e.style.removeProperty("z-index");
}
function reopenable091(id){
  const e=document.getElementById(id);
  if(!e)return;
  e.classList.remove("dc091Closed");
  e.style.removeProperty("pointer-events");
  if(e.style.getPropertyPriority("display")==="important")e.style.removeProperty("display");
}
function unlock091(){
  try{
    window.dungeonCombatActive=false;
    if(window.dungeonTurn156){
      dungeonTurn156.active=false;
      dungeonTurn156.aiBusy=false;
    }
    window.dc036AllowCombatClose=false;
    window.dc040VictoryOpen=false;
  }catch(e){}

  [
    "dungeonCombatModal",
    "dungeonCombatVictoryModal",
    "dungeonCombatStatsModal",
    "dc036AiPopup",
    "dc032AiPopup"
  ].forEach(hide091);

  /* Les popups de jets peuvent aussi rester au-dessus après la dernière attaque. */
  ["specialDiceModal","attackDiceModal"].forEach(id=>{
    const e=document.getElementById(id);
    if(!e)return;
    e.classList.remove("open");
    e.style.display="none";
    e.style.pointerEvents="none";
  });

  document.body.style.removeProperty("overflow");
  document.body.style.removeProperty("pointer-events");
  document.documentElement.style.removeProperty("overflow");
  document.documentElement.style.removeProperty("pointer-events");

  const core=document.getElementById("gensDungeonCore01");
  if(core){
    core.style.display="block";
    core.style.removeProperty("pointer-events");
  }

  /* Le host de combat est contenu dans le modal, mais certaines anciennes couches
     lui donnaient un display autonome. On le vide et on le neutralise. */
  const host=document.getElementById("dungeonCombatSetupView");
  if(host){
    host.innerHTML="";
    host.style.display="none";
    host.style.pointerEvents="none";
  }

  try{DungeonCore01?.render?.()}catch(e){}
  try{window.renderTacticalMovement090?.()}catch(e){}
}
window.dungeonPostCombatUnlock091=unlock091;

/* Victoire : CONTINUER doit toujours finir par cette sortie unique. */
const finish091=window.finishDungeonCombatVictory;
if(typeof finish091==="function"){
  window.finishDungeonCombatVictory=function(){
    let r;
    try{r=finish091.apply(this,arguments)}
    catch(e){console.warn("Core 0.91 finish victory",e)}
    unlock091();
    requestAnimationFrame(unlock091);
    return r;
  };
}

/* Même garde pour toute fermeture normale du combat. */
const close091=window.closeDungeonCombat;
if(typeof close091==="function"){
  window.closeDungeonCombat=function(){
    const wasActive=!!window.dungeonCombatActive;
    let r;
    try{r=close091.apply(this,arguments)}
    catch(e){console.warn("Core 0.91 close combat",e)}
    if(!window.dungeonCombatActive || !wasActive){
      unlock091();
      requestAnimationFrame(unlock091);
    }
    return r;
  };
}

/* Avant un nouveau combat, enlever le marqueur "fermé" afin que le modal puisse s'ouvrir. */
const engage091=window.dc030EngageCombat;
if(typeof engage091==="function"){
  window.dc030EngageCombat=function(){
    ["dungeonCombatModal","dungeonCombatVictoryModal","dungeonCombatStatsModal","dc036AiPopup","dc032AiPopup"].forEach(reopenable091);
    const host=document.getElementById("dungeonCombatSetupView");
    if(host){
      host.style.removeProperty("pointer-events");
      host.style.removeProperty("display");
    }
    return engage091.apply(this,arguments);
  };
}

/* Embuscade utilise également la même préparation. */
const amb091=window.dc076StartAmbushCombat;
if(typeof amb091==="function"){
  window.dc076StartAmbushCombat=function(){
    ["dungeonCombatModal","dungeonCombatVictoryModal","dungeonCombatStatsModal","dc036AiPopup","dc032AiPopup"].forEach(reopenable091);
    const host=document.getElementById("dungeonCombatSetupView");
    if(host){
      host.style.removeProperty("pointer-events");
      host.style.removeProperty("display");
    }
    return amb091.apply(this,arguments);
  };
}

/* Sécurité ciblée : après la mort du dernier ennemi, vérifier qu'aucune couche
   de combat invisible n'est encore active une fois le popup victoire fermé. */
document.addEventListener("click",function(ev){
  const b=ev.target?.closest?.("button");
  if(!b)return;
  const txt=String(b.textContent||"").trim().toUpperCase();
  if(txt==="CONTINUER" && b.closest?.("#dungeonCombatVictoryModal")){
    setTimeout(unlock091,0);
    setTimeout(unlock091,80);
  }
},false);

try{
  const badge=document.querySelector(".dc01Badge");
  if(badge)badge.textContent="NOUVEAU MOTEUR · CORE 1.05";
  const f=document.querySelector(".dc01Footer");
  if(f)f.textContent="Dungeon Core 1.05 · Movement V2 · déverrouillage post-combat.";
}catch(e){}
})();
</script>

<script type="application/x-gensrpg-disabled" id="dungeonCore100ResumeAndInteractionFix">
(function(){
"use strict";

const SESSION_PROFILE_KEY="gensrpg_session_profile_100_v1";
const CORE_KEY="gensrpg_dungeon_core02_v1";
const MOVE_KEY="gensrpg_dungeon_tactical098_v1";
const RUNTIME_KEY100="gensrpg_dungeon_runtime_v2";

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   SESSION : mémoriser le vrai univers au démarrage.
--------------------------------------------------------- */
function readProfiles100(){
  try{return loadGameProfiles?.()||[]}catch(e){return []}
}
function profileFamily100(p){
  try{return gensContentFamilyForProfile?.(p)||""}catch(e){return ""}
}
function readCore100(){
  for(const storageKey of [RUNTIME_KEY100,CORE_KEY]){
    try{
      const x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storageKey)||"null");
      if(x&&typeof x==="object"&&Array.isArray(x.participants)&&x.participants.length)return x;
    }catch(e){}
  }
  return {};
}
function readMove100(){
  try{
    const x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(MOVE_KEY)||"null");
    return x&&typeof x==="object"?x:null;
  }catch(e){return null}
}
function saveSessionProfile100(){
  try{
    const id=String(activeGameProfileId?.()||"");
    const p=readProfiles100().find(x=>String(x.id)===id);
    if(!p)return;
    localStorage.setItem(SESSION_PROFILE_KEY,JSON.stringify({
      profileId:id,
      family:profileFamily100(p),
      gameStyle:String(p.gameStyle||""),
      savedAt:Date.now()
    }));
  }catch(e){}
}
window.dungeonSaveSessionProfile100=saveSessionProfile100;

/* Le lancement Dungeon final mémorise le profil exact. */
if(window.DungeonCore01 && typeof DungeonCore01.start==="function"){
  const oldStart100=DungeonCore01.start;
  DungeonCore01.start=function(){
    saveSessionProfile100();
    const r=oldStart100.apply(this,arguments);
    saveSessionProfile100();
    return r;
  };
}

/* Le lancement générique mémorise aussi le profil dès qu'une session devient active. */
try{
  const oldMark100=window.markSessionActive;
  if(typeof oldMark100==="function"){
    window.markSessionActive=function(v){
      const r=oldMark100.apply(this,arguments);
      if(v)saveSessionProfile100();
      else{
        try{localStorage.removeItem(SESSION_PROFILE_KEY)}catch(e){}
      }
      return r;
    };
  }
}catch(e){}

/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   REPRENDRE : retrouver le vrai profil Dungeon RPG.
--------------------------------------------------------- */
function resolveSessionProfile100(){
  const profiles=readProfiles100();

  // 1. Nouvelle mémoire explicite de session.
  try{
    const x=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SESSION_PROFILE_KEY)||"null");
    if(x?.profileId){
      const p=profiles.find(q=>String(q.id)===String(x.profileId));
      if(p)return p;
    }
  }catch(e){}

  // 2. Le profil actuellement actif est déjà un vrai Dungeon RPG.
  try{
    const id=String(activeGameProfileId?.()||"");
    const p=profiles.find(q=>String(q.id)===id);
    if(p?.gameStyle==="dungeon" && profileFamily100(p)==="rpg")return p;
  }catch(e){}

  // 3. Ancienne sauvegarde : retrouver le RPG correspondant aux participants.
  const participants=(readCore100()?.participants||[]).map(String).filter(Boolean);
  const candidates=profiles.filter(p=>p?.gameStyle==="dungeon" && profileFamily100(p)==="rpg");
  if(participants.length && candidates.length){
    const scored=candidates.map(p=>{
      const pool=new Set((p.heroPool||[]).map(String));
      let score=0;
      for(const id of participants){
        if(pool.has(id))score+=10;
        if(["dungeon_aldren","dungeon_lyra","dungeon_brom"].includes(id) &&
           String(p.id)===String(window.GAME_PROFILE_DUNGEON_ID||"game_profile_dungeon_demo"))score+=8;
      }
      return {p,score};
    }).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score);
    if(scored[0]?.score>0)return scored[0].p;
  }

  // 4. Dernier recours : démo Dungeon classique, jamais Monster Capture.
  return candidates.find(p=>String(p.id)===String(window.GAME_PROFILE_DUNGEON_ID||"game_profile_dungeon_demo"))
      || candidates[0]
      || null;
}

function hideForeignGameUi100(){
  [
    "captureGameHub","captureHeroSheet","menu","sheet","pregameSetup",
    "sessionHeroSetup","sessionObjectSetup","sessionWaveSetup","sessionDungeonSetup",
    "editorHub","gameProfileEditor","heroManager","enemyManager","objectManager",
    "zombieManager","gameCustomization","dungeonAdvancedEditor"
  ].forEach(id=>{
    const e=document.getElementById(id);
    if(e)e.style.display="none";
  });
}


/* ---------------------------------------------------------
   COFFRES / CACHES : proximité exacte.
--------------------------------------------------------- */
function currentHeroPosition100(){
  const mv=readMove100();
  const c=readCore100();
  const p=Array.isArray(c.participants)?c.participants.map(String):[];
  const i=Math.max(0,Math.min(Number(c.index)||0,Math.max(0,p.length-1)));
  const id=String(p[i]||"");
  const pos=Number(mv?.positions?.[id]);
  return {id,pos:Number.isInteger(pos)?pos:-1,mv};
}
function chestTarget100(el){
  const s=loadDungeonState?.()||{};
  const map=s?.last?.map||{};
  const cells=Array.isArray(map.cells)?map.cells:[];
  const candidates=[
    el?.cellIndex, el?.cellIdx, el?.mapIndex, el?.mapIdx,
    map?.chestIdx,
    cells.indexOf("chest"),
    cells.indexOf("cache")
  ];
  for(const v of candidates){
    const n=Number(v);
    if(Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=0&&n<cells.length)return n;
  }
  return -1;
}
function toast100(t){
  try{
    if(typeof showToast==="function")showToast(t);
    else DungeonCore01?.modal?.("Information",t);
  }catch(e){}
}

/* Ce wrapper est placé EN DERNIER : aucun ancien défi/coffre ne peut le contourner. */
if(window.DungeonCore01 && typeof DungeonCore01.searchChest==="function"){
  const oldSearch100=DungeonCore01.searchChest;
  DungeonCore01.searchChest=function(id){
    let tactical=false;
    try{tactical=!!dungeonTacticalMovementEnabled098?.()}catch(e){}

    if(tactical){
      const all=loadDungeonSceneElements?.()||[];
      const el=all.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id) && x.kind==="chest");
      const hero=currentHeroPosition100();
      const target=chestTarget100(el);

      if(target<0){
        toast100("📍 Cette cache n'a pas de case liée sur la carte. Elle ne peut pas être fouillée à distance.");
        return;
      }
      if(hero.pos!==target){
        toast100("📍 Le héros actif doit être exactement sur la case de la cache pour la fouiller.");
        return;
      }

      // Persiste la liaison pour les prochains rendus / reprises.
      if(el && !Number.isInteger(Number(el.cellIndex))){
        el.cellIndex=target;
        try{saveDungeonSceneElements?.(all)}catch(e){}
      }
    }

    return oldSearch100.apply(this,arguments);
  };
}

/* Lorsqu'une cache de carte existe, lui associer sa vraie case. */
function bindRoomChests100(){
  try{
    const s=loadDungeonState?.()||{};
    const map=s?.last?.map||{};
    const cells=Array.isArray(map.cells)?map.cells:[];
    let idx=Number(map.chestIdx);
    if(!Number.isInteger(idx)||idx<0||idx>=cells.length)idx=cells.indexOf("chest");
    if(idx<0)return;

    const room=Number(s.room)||0;
    const all=loadDungeonSceneElements?.()||[];
    let changed=false;
    all.filter(x=>x.kind==="chest"&&Number(x.room||0)===room).forEach(el=>{
      if(!Number.isInteger(Number(el.cellIndex))){
        el.cellIndex=idx;
        changed=true;
      }
    });
    if(changed)saveDungeonSceneElements?.(all);
  }catch(e){}
}
window.dungeonBindRoomChests100=bindRoomChests100;

if(window.DungeonCore01 && typeof DungeonCore01.render==="function"){
  const oldRender100=DungeonCore01.render;
  DungeonCore01.render=function(){
    const r=oldRender100.apply(this,arguments);
    bindRoomChests100();
    return r;
  };
}

setTimeout(()=>{
  try{
    if(hasActiveSession?.())saveSessionProfile100();
    bindRoomChests100();
  }catch(e){}
},0);

try{
  const b=document.querySelector(".dc01Badge");
  if(b)b.textContent="NOUVEAU MOTEUR · CORE 1.05";
  const f=document.querySelector(".dc01Footer");
  if(f)f.textContent="Dungeon Core 1.05 · reprise isolée · caches tactiques · UI nettoyée.";
}catch(e){}
})();
</script>

<script type="application/x-gensrpg-disabled" id="dungeonCore101CacheGuard">
(function(){
"use strict";

const CORE_KEY="gensrpg_dungeon_core02_v1";
const MOVE_KEY="gensrpg_dungeon_tactical098_v1";

function jget(k,fallback){
  try{return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)||"null")||fallback}catch(e){return fallback}
}
function tactical(){
  try{return !!dungeonTacticalMovementEnabled098?.()}catch(e){return false}
}
function heroPos(){
  const c=jget(CORE_KEY,{}), mv=jget(MOVE_KEY,{});
  const p=Array.isArray(c.participants)?c.participants.map(String):[];
  const i=Math.max(0,Math.min(Number(c.index)||0,Math.max(0,p.length-1)));
  const id=String(p[i]||"");
  const pos=Number(mv?.positions?.[id]);
  return Number.isInteger(pos)?pos:-1;
}
function roomMap(){
  try{return loadDungeonState?.()?.last?.map||{}}catch(e){return {}}
}
function targetIndex(){
  const m=roomMap(), cells=Array.isArray(m.cells)?m.cells:[];
  const vals=[m.chestIdx,m.cacheIdx,cells.indexOf("chest"),cells.indexOf("cache")];
  for(const v of vals){
    const n=Number(v);
    if(Number.isInteger(n)&&n>=0&&n<cells.length)return n;
  }
  return -1;
}
function onTarget(){
  if(!tactical())return true;
  const hp=heroPos(), ti=targetIndex();
  return hp>=0 && ti>=0 && hp===ti;
}
function tell(){
  try{
    if(typeof showToast==="function")showToast("📍 Le héros actif doit être exactement sur la case de la cache.");
    else DungeonCore01?.modal?.("Cache","📍 Le héros actif doit être exactement sur la case de la cache.");
  }catch(e){}
}

/* Guard the public chest function itself. */
if(window.DungeonCore01 && typeof DungeonCore01.searchChest==="function"){
  const old=window.DungeonCore01.searchChest;
  window.DungeonCore01.searchChest=function(){
    if(tactical()&&!onTarget()){tell();return false}
    return old.apply(this,arguments);
  };
}

/* Guard common global chest/cache entry points if present. */
[
  "dungeonSearchChest","dungeonOpenChest","dungeonOpenCache",
  "openDungeonChest","openDungeonCache","searchDungeonChest",
  "dc075OpenChest","dc075SearchChest"
].forEach(name=>{
  const fn=window[name];
  if(typeof fn!=="function")return;
  window[name]=function(){
    if(tactical()&&!onTarget()){tell();return false}
    return fn.apply(this,arguments);
  };
});

/* Most important: capture-phase DOM guard.
   This runs BEFORE inline onclick / bubbling handlers and prevents an
   off-cell cache from entering the old modal/challenge chain at all. */
document.addEventListener("click",function(ev){
  if(!tactical()||onTarget())return;
  const el=ev.target?.closest?.("button,[role='button'],a");
  if(!el)return;
  const txt=String((el.textContent||"")+" "+(el.id||"")+" "+(el.className||"")).toLowerCase();
  const isCache=/cache|coffre|fouill|chest/.test(txt);
  if(!isCache)return;

  // Do not block GM/editor buttons.
  if(/mj|gm|editor|edit|ajout|add/.test(txt))return;

  ev.preventDefault();
  ev.stopPropagation();
  ev.stopImmediatePropagation();
  tell();
  try{dc099Paint?.();dc099SyncMainAction?.()}catch(e){}
},true);

/* Diagnostic only. */
window.dungeonCacheDebug101=function(){
  return {
    tactical:tactical(),
    heroPosition:heroPos(),
    targetPosition:targetIndex(),
    allowed:onTarget()
  };
};

try{
  const b=document.querySelector(".dc01Badge");if(b)b.textContent="NOUVEAU MOTEUR · CORE 1.05";
  const f=document.querySelector(".dc01Footer");if(f)f.textContent="Dungeon Core 1.05 · garde cache avant interaction.";
}catch(e){}
})();
</script>

<script type="application/x-gensrpg-disabled" id="dungeonCore102RoomCycleFix">
(function(){
"use strict";

const LOCK_CHANCE=20; // valeur provisoire équilibrée ; sera éditable plus tard.

/* ============================================================
   A. VERROU DE SORTIE PAR SALLE
   - plus besoin de tuer systématiquement toute la salle
   - ~20 % des salles ennemies : un monstre porte la clé
   - boss : sortie verrouillée jusqu'à sa défaite
   ============================================================ */
function ds102(){
  try{return loadDungeonState?.()||{room:0,last:null}}catch(e){return {room:0,last:null}}
}
function living102(){
  try{return (dungeonLivingEnemies?.()||[]).filter(e=>e&&!e.defeated&&Number(e.hp)>0)}catch(e){return []}
}
function saveDs102(x){
  try{saveDungeonState?.(x)}catch(e){}
}
function initRoomLock102(){
  const d=ds102(),last=d?.last;
  if(!last||!Number(last.room))return false;
  const kind=String(last.kind||"");
  if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(last,"exitLocked"))return !!last.exitLocked;

  const enemies=living102();
  if(!enemies.length){
    last.exitLocked=false;
    saveDs102(d);
    return false;
  }

  let locked=false;
  if(kind==="boss")locked=true;
  else if(kind==="enemy"||kind==="ambush")locked=Math.random()*100<LOCK_CHANCE;

  last.exitLocked=locked;
  if(locked){
    const carrier=enemies[Math.floor(Math.random()*enemies.length)];
    last.keyEnemyId=String(carrier?.id||"");
  }else{
    last.keyEnemyId="";
  }
  saveDs102(d);
  return locked;
}

window.dungeonRoomExitLocked102=function(){
  const d=ds102(),last=d?.last;
  if(!last)return false;

  if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(last,"exitLocked")){
    initRoomLock102();
  }

  if(!last.exitLocked)return false;

  const live=living102();
  if(!live.length){
    last.exitLocked=false;
    last.keyEnemyId="";
    saveDs102(d);
    return false;
  }

  const key=String(last.keyEnemyId||"");
  if(key && !live.some(e=>String(e.id)===key)){
    last.exitLocked=false;
    last.keyEnemyId="";
    saveDs102(d);
    try{
      if(typeof showToast==="function")showToast("🔑 Clé récupérée ! La sortie est maintenant ouverte.");
    }catch(e){}
    return false;
  }
  return true;
};

/* ============================================================
   B. MARQUEURS MONSTRES = ENNEMIS RÉELLEMENT VIVANTS
   Les cases enemy excédentaires deviennent du sol vide.
   ============================================================ */
window.dungeonSyncEnemyMarkers102=function(){
  try{
    const d=ds102(),m=d?.last?.map;
    if(!m||!Array.isArray(m.cells))return false;

    const liveCount=living102().length;
    const enemyIdx=[];
